subject: science
passage: In 1941, after a walk in the Swiss countryside, engineer George de Mestral noticed burdock burrs stuck to his dog's fur. Studying them under a microscope, ______ He later used this idea to design Velcro, a fastener made of one strip of fabric with tiny hooks and another with tiny loops.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: de Mestral's microscope showed tiny hooks on the burrs.
choices.B: de Mestral saw that the burrs were covered in tiny hooks.
choices.C: tiny hooks were found covering the burrs.
choices.D: the burrs were seen to be covered in tiny hooks.

explanation.why: The phrase "Studying them under a microscope" describes the person who did the studying, so that person must be named right after the comma. Only one choice begins with "de Mestral."
explanation.A: Incorrect. This choice says the microscope studied the burrs; "de Mestral's" only describes the microscope, which is the subject.
explanation.B: Correct. "De Mestral" comes right after the introductory phrase, so it is clear he studied the burrs.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This choice says tiny hooks did the studying, which makes no sense.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This choice says the burrs studied themselves under a microscope.
